title: Leo Emoji ♌ Meaning: Lion Sign of Main Character Energy
description: The ♌ Leo emoji is the zodiac sign of the Lion, for birthdays from July 23 to August 22. See how it is used for confidence, attention, and Leo season.
summary: The ♌ Leo emoji stands for Leo, the Lion, the zodiac sign of people born from about July 23 to August 22. It announces a star sign and, in jokes and captions, signals confidence, love of attention, and the showy self-assurance astrology associates with Leos.
meaning: The Leo glyph is a small circle with a long tail that arches up and curls back down. It is generally explained as a lion's mane or tail. On the emoji keyboard it does one job: it identifies the fifth sign of the zodiac. Leos add it to bios, tag it on birthday photos, and reply with it when asked their sign.

Astrologers call Leo a fixed fire sign and give it the Sun as ruler, the only sign with that distinction. From there comes the image of a person who is warm, generous, loyal, and happiest at the center of the room. Social media shortens this to "main character energy." The meme Leo checks every mirror, expects a month-long birthday, and takes compliments as simple fact.

Leo season, running through the hottest part of the Northern Hemisphere summer, is one of the most celebrated stretches on astrology accounts, partly because Leos promote it so eagerly. The emoji is rarely an insult. Even when ♌ is used to call someone dramatic or vain, it comes with affection, and Leos are known for accepting the label as praise.

contexts.label: In captions
contexts.body: Selfies, stage photos, and birthday posts are natural settings. A caption as short as "♌ season" tells followers the poster is feeling themselves. Pairing it with 👑, ☀️, or 🦁 is common. Performers and influencers born under the sign use it as part of their personal branding.

contexts.label: In texting
contexts.body: Friends use ♌ to explain a dramatic entrance, a need for praise, or a fierce defense of a loved one. It can soften a tease: "you took forty selfies ♌." It also works as a compliment for someone who commands attention without trying.

contexts.label: From a crush
contexts.body: When a date sends their sign, they are offering an easy topic. Astrology fans expect a Leo to be openly affectionate and to want appreciation in return. Responding with your own sign, or a joke about compatibility, keeps the conversation going.

examples.text: It's my birthday month, I don't make the rules ♌👑
examples.meaning: A Leo claiming the whole month as a personal celebration.

examples.text: Walked in late so everyone would look ♌
examples.meaning: The sender jokes about enjoying attention, as Leos are said to.
A birthday listed with the sign and its ruling Sun.

examples.text: Say what you want about ♌s but they hype up their friends
examples.meaning: Praise for the sign's reputation for loyalty and generosity.

examples.text: Leo sun ♌ Leo rising ♌ I'm sorry in advance
examples.meaning: A joke about having a double dose of Leo traits.

combos.meaning: Royalty and confidence; the Leo as king or queen.
Leo with its ruler, the Sun; summer birthdays.

confusedWith.difference: 🦁 is the animal's face and is used for courage, wildlife, sports mascots, and fictional lions as well as for Leo. ♌ is specific to astrology and would not be used for an actual lion.

⛎ shares the purple tile and looks like a U crossed by a wavy line. It stands for Ophiuchus, sometimes called the thirteenth sign, and is not part of the standard twelve. The Leo glyph is a single looping stroke.

avoid: Do not use ♌ to mock someone as arrogant if they are sensitive about it; the humor depends on them being in on it.
Avoid treating it as a lion or cat emoji in non-astrology messages, where it will not be understood.
design: A white curving line that begins in a small loop, sweeps over an arch, and finishes in a flick, placed on a purple square. Some people see the Greek letter omega turned upside down. Major platforms render it alike, and it matches the other eleven zodiac tiles in color and style.

faqs.q: What are the dates for Leo ♌?
faqs.a: Approximately July 23 to August 22. As with every sign, the borders can move by a day depending on the year, so someone born on July 22 or 23 may need a birth chart to be sure.

Confidence, showmanship, and warmth: acting as though the spotlight is yours. The phrase comes from astrological descriptions of the sign and is used for anyone behaving that way, whether or not they were born under it.

faqs.q: What does ♌ mean in a bio?
faqs.a: The account owner's sun sign is Leo. Placed second or third in a set of zodiac emoji, it would instead be their moon or rising sign. Some people also use it just to signal a bold personality.
In astrology Leo is ruled by the Sun, which astronomers classify as a star but astrologers count among the "planets." This is why Leos are linked with shining, vitality, and being at the center.
